habitConfig.orEnterNewGroupName: Or enter a new group name:
habitConfig.syncInfo: Some fields are locked because this habit is synchronized with others. To edit these fields, select "edit for all" on the habit detail page (requires permission).
habitConfig.tooltipAsMuchAsPossible: A challenge where you can log as much as you want each day. The user with the highest total value wins
habitConfig.tooltipChallengeComputation: How the challenge winner will be determined. Absolute percentage means that the 'normal' percentage of completion is beeing used at the end of the month. Relative percentage means that the participant with the highest percentage counts as 100%. Highest value means that for each participant only the highest day-value ist counted
habitConfig.tooltipCustomDays: The X in 'Y times per X days'.
habitConfig.tooltipDailyGoal: Value to be used as default entry for single clicks in the habit tracker. Add a + or - to increase or decrease the value by default
habitConfig.tooltipFrequency: The Y in 'Y times per X days'.
habitConfig.tooltipFrequencySettings: Configure how often you want to perform this habit.
habitConfig.tooltipFrequencyType: Choose the time period for your frequency. Weekly: 'Y times per week' Monthly: 'Y times per month', Custom Period: 'Y times per X days'
habitConfig.tooltipHabitType: Choose between a numerical habit (e.g., minutes, pages) or a boolean habit (e.g., done/not done)
habitConfig.tooltipIsNegative: Enable this for habits you want to reduce or avoid (e.g., snacks, coffee). Lower values will count as better progress
habitConfig.tooltipMaxDailyValue: The maximum value you can achieve in a single day/week/month. This has to be achieved for a day to count as completed
habitConfig.tooltipMaxDailyValueNegative: The maximum value you should reach in a single day/week/month. If this is exceeded the day will count as not completed
habitConfig.tooltipTargetDays: Number of days used for progress calculation (default: 30). When computing the current progress the last X days will be used, where X is the targetDays value
habitConfig.tooltipUnit: The unit of measurement for your habit (e.g., minutes, pages, reps)
habitConfig.tooltipWeekdayFilter: Select specific weekdays when this habit should be tracked. If at least one day is selected, only those days will count towards habit completion.
